output.summary: An annual or perennial flowering herb native to the United States, Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean and northern South America, marsh fleabane inhabits wetlands, coastal habitats and moist inland sites, often on salty ground. It is strongly aromatic and roughly hairy, with toothed oval leaves and clusters of bright pinkish-purple or magenta flower heads.
output.edibilityNote: In parts of the Caribbean, the leaves are consumed as medicinal tea; use is discouraged during pregnancy and advised in moderation.
